note: Every image the site can display, and where it came from. Drive is the source of truth for Masinloc photography: assets/ holds only files supplied by the project. scripts/check-photography.py fails the build if a page references an image that is not listed here, or if any page pulls an image from an external host.
rules: No stock photography: Unsplash, Pexels, Shutterstock, Getty or similar.
No image may be relabelled as a place it does not show.
Presentation may be improved by cropping, overlay, layout, typography, motion and colour treatment. The physical identity of a place must not be altered.

cards.note: The finished 1:1 pubmats. Each already carries the logo, place name, description, things-to-do and tags, so it is used whole as the shareable card and never has type laid over it. Built at 600 and 1200px.

pending.mapping: Fixed in data/locations.json. Each raw photograph was matched against the photograph embedded in the correspondingly labelled pubmat, so the place name comes from the project's own labelling.

unassigned.decision: Not used. Cannot be tied to a named place, so it is never labelled as a location.

campaigns.origin: Google Drive - Masinloc Website Asset / Ads
campaigns.note: Approved campaign artwork. Each file is a finished design carrying its own logo, headline and copy, so it is shown whole and never cropped, retyped or regenerated. Mapping is fixed in data/campaigns.json; built by scripts/build-campaigns.py.

leadership.note: Painted official portraits of the Municipal Mayor and former Municipal Mayors of Masinloc, supplied by the project. Every portrait is cropped to the same 4:5, resized through the same width ladder and encoded at the same quality by scripts/build-leadership.py — no per-person crop, size, sharpening or retouching. Faces are never altered. Mapping is fixed in data/leadership.json.
